validation-quadrature-controls.html:
Domain-aware, double-exponential and sparse-grid quadrature

Compare fixed integrals with domain-aware methods, separating estimated errors, actual errors, budget exits and underresolution controls.

These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems.

Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved.

Download and execute the supplement

Run inside atlas-quadrature-controls-2026-11-25 from the ZIP. This command executes all 3 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs.

python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python -m pytest -q
python run.py --input inputs.json --output output

Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it.

validation-approximation-controls.html:
Fixed interpolation, spline and Haar controls

Small fixed examples separate nodes, representation and rounding; C2 continuity and shape preservation; and boundary extension and shifts.

These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems.

Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved.

Download and execute the supplement

Run inside atlas-approximation-controls-2026-11-25 from the ZIP. This command executes all 3 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs.

python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python -m pytest -q
python run.py --input inputs.json --output output

Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it.

Assumptions, units and boundaries

Dimensionless interval [-1,1], degrees 8, 16 and 32, and 2048 fixed midpoints. Actual binary64 nodes, data and weights define the discrete problem.

Editorial clarification

A sampled maximum error is not a proof of a continuous uniform norm. Closed weights and discrete orthogonality on rounded nodes are not treated as exact. No arbitrary-degree or all-point stability guarantee is made.

Formulation, approximation and diagnostic scope

Train a hard-boundary tanh ansatz with trust-region reflective least squares and an analytic parameter Jacobian. Retain every returned model under the fixed budget. Also solve second-order finite differences with 31, 63 and 127 unknowns using the Thomas algorithm.

  • Poisson / Laplace equations

    Solve dimensionless −uₓₓ=π² sin(πx) on [0,1] with zero Dirichlet data. Use sixteen hidden units, 49 real parameters, seeds 8401–8403, 64 training points and 257 separate evaluation points.

Check Hodgkin–Huxley clamps, rest and firing alongside exact immigration–death SSA transient laws on fixed small inputs.

These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems.

Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved.

validation-thermostat-constraint-control.html:
Deterministic thermostats and constrained degrees of freedom

Compare thermostats on small harmonic/quartic systems and check effective degrees of freedom, momentum covariance and transient distributions under fixed linear constraints. Retain unmet statistical goals.

These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems.

Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved.

Download and execute the supplement

Run inside atlas-thermostat-constraint-controls-2026-11-25 from the ZIP. This command executes all 2 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs.

python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python -m pytest -q
python run.py --input inputs.json --output output

validation-quantum-small.title: Small quantum models and saved-reference cards
validation-quantum-small.html:
Small quantum models and saved-reference cards

Fixed two-state dynamics,1D eigenpairs,minimal molecules and a3-wave model plus saved H/He and periodic-He audits. Broad expensive tails remain unverified.

These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems.

Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved.

Download and execute the supplement

Run inside atlas-quantum-small-2026-11-25 from the ZIP. This command executes all 7 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs.

python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python -m pytest -q
python run.py --input inputs.json --output output

Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it.

A two-state BO / CP-type model with a short nuclear thermostat coupling

Compare a normalized two-state electronic degree of freedom coupled to a nuclear coordinate, short NVE and one nuclear OU bath.

Methods, equations, figures and references

Methods used

  • Born–Oppenheimer molecular dynamics / BOMD
  • Car–Parrinello molecular dynamics / CPMD
  • Langevin thermostat
  • Velocity Verlet / particle leapfrog

Methods used by this fixed-input execution. Their guides describe applicable conditions and the checked scope.

Equations

This example’s formulation and conditions

Use analytic BO forces and the declared CP-type action with Verlet/BAOAB; record nuclear heat and fictitious electronic kinetic energy separately.

  • Two-state electronic-angle/nuclear BO and CP-type model

    Actual coupled normalized electronic angle and nuclear coordinate, short NVE plus one nuclear OU trajectory. No first-principles/long NVE/canonical sampling/production CPMD. BO and mu.04 state comparisons use fixed4096/8192 RK4 companions; mu.01 receives energy checks only. Authored dimensionless model units with M=20 and angular fictitious mass mu=.04/.01; these are not cp.x emass units.

validation-continuum-particle-controls.html:
Scoped ALE piston, sphere transport and SPH/GSPH controls

Fixed prescribed-ALE piston, limited sphere transport and axisymmetric balance, plus actual GSPH and separate SPH controls.

These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems.

Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved.

Download and execute the supplement

Run inside atlas-continuum-particle-controls-2026-11-25 from the ZIP. This command executes all 5 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs.

python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python -m pytest -q
python run.py --input inputs.json --output output

Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it.
